Field
Description
DeviceDescriptorSetHash
The SHA-256 hash of all hardware descriptors located in a device's firmware.
InterfaceDescriptorName
The name of the device interface descriptor.
InterfaceDescriptorNumber
The zero-based index number of the interface descriptor.
InterfaceDescriptorAlternateSetting The index of an interface descriptor that contains alternate properties for this interface.
InterfaceDescriptorNumEndpoints
The number of endpoint descriptors located within this interface descriptor.
DeviceUsbClass
The USB specification class of the device.
DeviceUsbSubclass
The USB specification subclass of the device.
DeviceProtocol
The USB specification protocol of the device.
DeviceDescriptorUniqueIdentifier
An identifier created by Device Control to uniquely identify a particular USB device hardware descriptor.
DeviceTimeStamp
The time stamp the device action (e.g., connect or disconnect) occurred, not the time the corresponding sensor event was
generated.
